verdict.rationale: Workers itself provides scheduled cron jobs, durable Workflows that chain steps, retry automatically and persist for up to weeks, and Queues and event subscriptions that trigger consumers when account events occur. The Agents SDK adds per-agent scheduling, with agents that hibernate and wake on demand, so recurring and event-driven background automation is first-party. A hands-on user reports success with Workflows, but another notes that CPU-time limits (30s free, 15 min paid) constrain long-running agent tasks. Missing for 10: in-depth cron-trigger documentation (only a one-line mention), clear evidence that execution limits don't constrain long autonomous runs, and setup is code-first rather than a configure-only automation builder.
